title: Add multicast shared-thread mailboxes with one sequence domain
outcome: Coordinators currently relay identical findings across several pairwise mailboxes and manually keep numbering/narratives aligned. This caused concrete finding-ID collisions across reviewers. Design multicast or shared-thread coordination where an authorized participant set receives one immutable message stream and one sequence domain, while retaining per-participant forward-only processed cursors, exact audit history, idempotent sends, and participant-scoped authorization.
acceptance: One send can target an explicit immutable participant set without N divergent copies; all participants observe the same message id and sequence ordering; acknowledgements remain independent and forward-only; membership/lifecycle, authorization, notification coalescing, idempotency, restart, deleted participants, and UI presentation are specified and deterministically tested.
